To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the duration, occurrence and coverage of EEG microstate classes are modulated by task-induced increased modularity-specific processing, and that the duration of microstate class A and the occurrence of microstate class B are modulated by personal modality-specific cognitive style and ability parameters.

verbal and visual conditions consistently affect the duration, occurrence and coverage of microstates A and B, and that modality-specific personal parameters do not consistently correlate with EEG microstate parameters except for verbal cognitive style which correlates negatively with microstate A duration and positively class C occurrence.
the duration, occurrence and coverage of the four EEG microstate clusters A, B, D, and C, as well as the topographies of classes A, B and D, depend on the modality of thinking.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the momentary functional state of the human brain and how it relates to modality-specific thinking.
the functional significance of the EEG microstates.
the functional significance of EEG brain electric field configurations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the functional significance of the EEG microstate parameters remains elusive.

the EEG microstates represent a functional state of the whole brain, but that the functional significance of the microstate classes is not limited to the modality they were originally hypothesized to be associated with.

the EEG microstates represent the momentary, global brain electric field configuration, which in turn represents the momentary global functional state of a brain that is continuously and dynamically engaged in the formation of thoughts.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the EEG microstates are a useful tool for the study of brain function.
EEG microstates represent the head-surfacemeasured activity of intra-crytical sources that are necessary for the formation of thoughts.
EEG microstate classes are not exclusively associated with the processing of a single modality but rather represent the momentary, global, functional state of the human brain.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the functional significance of EEG brain states can only be understood in the context of their dynamic interplay with all other states.
the EEG microstates are not a static phenomenon but a highly dynamic one, and that their functional significance may be better understood by considering their dynamic interplay.
, although the EEG microstate approach is still in its infancy, it has great potential for the investigation of the functional organization of the brain.
